profile.headline: Java Developer | Lifelong Learner | Tech Elevator Java Graduate
profile.summary:
Oh hello there!

I am Katherine - A passionate learner and coder!
I often think that the human brain is a crazy place, and in my brain, there are two things that fascinate me the most are coding and learning.

After graduating with my Master’s degree in Education, I fell in love with coding, and it really excites me whenever I come across a problem, I get curious about solving it and whenever I got an idea, I have the ability to bring it to life.

Before joining Tech Elevator, I spent around a year learning how to code on my own and I even successfully built a few websites with front-end/back-end languages. I found it is really satisfying to build something from scratch to a fully functional website. 

Specialties: Spring Boot, Java, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue.js, Responsive Design, IntelliJ, Git, Unit Testing (JUnit), JSON

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with other software engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to design and develop innovative solutions that met the organization's business needs.
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and address software issues and bugs.
- Building and maintaining RESTful APIs to support front-end application development.
- Conducting code reviews and contributing to team knowledge-sharing sessions to improve overall software quality.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst I
positions.description:
-Collaborate directly with business analysts and others to implement user requirements into technical solutions.
-Participate in all parts of system development, testing, and support, and in the development of a continuous build architecture.

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description: - Currently attending a 14-week full-stack coding Bootcamp learning how to create dynamic web-based software systems using Java providing 700+ hours of development education and application.

positions.title: Client Advisor
positions.description:
- Organized and prioritized work to complete assignments in a timely, efficient manner.
- Promoted a positive public image for the company and worked to control the dissemination of information. 
- Increased client satisfaction and doubled sales goals during my first year.

positions.title: Attraction & Merchandise Cast Member
positions.description:
-One of Disney Cultural Representative Program members, designed to convey knowledge of Chinese culture and create an authentic Chinese environment for customers.
-Communicated effectively with the site supervisor, and other staff within the organization; accepted and applied critiques and suggestions to daily work in an effort to become more productive and efficient. 
-Designed and setup advertising signs and displays of merchandise on shelves, counters, or tables to attract customers and promote sales.
